exemplars.title: Beyond Text Generation: Supporting Writers with Continuous Automatic Text Summaries
exemplars.why: This is the most complete match to the structural signature: every paragraph in one continuous text becomes a persistent card, and reorder, delete, and merge operations are explicitly scoped to those cards.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: Chosen over rid 4266 because the evidence establishes both a one-to-one partition and concrete unit-level operations, while rid 4266 establishes typed blocks but does not enumerate their handles.

exemplars.title: Compositional Structures as Substrates for Human-AI Co-creation Environment: A Design Approach and A Case Study
exemplars.why: The narrative remains visibly and persistently structured as a linear sequence of typed section and paragraph blocks, providing addressable units at two useful granularities and making the mechanism broadly transferable.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: Chosen over rid 16862 because its linear blocks form a clearer non-overlapping partition, whereas IntentFlow’s high-level goal and low-level intents may be overlapping semantic layers.

exemplars.title: IntentFlow: Investigating Fluid Dynamics of Intent Communication in Generative AI
exemplars.why: IntentFlow converts a monolithic prompt into persistent, named goal and intent components that can be edited independently, demonstrating that addressable segmentation can apply to intent structure as well as document layout.
exemplars.over_the_runner_up: Chosen over rid 9433 because it supports revision of each component, while Mapping Movies uses its exceptionally clear segment cards primarily for navigation and playback.

notes: I departed substantially from the consensus by promoting rid 13462 from sixth to first and excluding consensus leader rid 13585. The +0.37 adjustment for rid 13462 reflects its unusually complete evidence for the structural signature: exhaustive paragraph-to-card mapping plus explicit per-unit operations. Rid 13585 has a powerful object-oriented framework and operation set, but its quote does not establish that the cells partition one continuous artifact into non-overlapping parts. Evidence should still be treated cautiously: none of the selected quotes supplies outcome evidence; rid 4266 does not explicitly list block-level controls; and rid 16862 does not prove that its goal and intent components are non-overlapping.
